security_audit.summary: Most markdown backtick and PowerShell findings are false positives because they are comments, code spans, or documented parameter values rather than executable code. Confirmed risks remain for outbound BrowserAct API calls, one documented external command, and unsafe guidance that asks users to provide an API key in chat.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide the API key in chat. Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or a secure secret manager, and never echo key values.
Document that search terms and authenticated requests are sent to BrowserAct. Tell users to avoid sensitive search terms and to review BrowserAct data handling terms.
Show argument-safe invocation guidance and instruct agents not to interpolate raw user text into shell command strings.
Move the timeout error and return into an else branch after the polling loop so finished tasks can retrieve and print results.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly guide users toward supplying an API key outside a secure environment variable setup. This is a credential-handling weakness, not just a variable naming issue.

content.value_statement: Finding recent Google News results manually is slow and inconsistent. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to collect headlines, sources, links, and publication times.
actual_capabilities: Accepts search keywords, publish date range, and maximum result count as command-line arguments.
Starts a BrowserAct Google News workflow with a fixed template ID.
Polls BrowserAct for task status and prints timestamped progress logs.
Checks for missing or invalid BrowserAct authorization and exits with user-facing errors.
Uses the BROWSERACT_API_KEY environment variable for authenticated BrowserAct requests.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and network access to BrowserAct.
The current script returns before reaching the result retrieval code after polling.
Results depend on BrowserAct workflow availability and Google News coverage.
Date filters are limited to the values documented by the skill.

use_cases.title: Track Industry Trends
use_cases.description: Collect recent Google News coverage for a market, technology, or policy topic.

use_cases.title: Monitor Brand Coverage
use_cases.description: Find recent media mentions for a brand, product, executive, or campaign.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor News
use_cases.description: Gather current articles about several competitors before preparing a market brief.

prompt_templates.title: Find Recent Topic Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Google News API skill to search for news about renewable energy from the past week. Limit results to 10 and summarize key themes.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor a Brand
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Google News for recent coverage of our brand from the past 24 hours. Return notable headlines, sources, publication times, and article links.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitor Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Collect Google News results for three competitors from the past week. Group results by company and identify launches, partnerships, and executive news.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Run targeted Google News searches for AI regulation, semiconductor exports, and cloud infrastructure. Use up to 30 results per topic and prepare a concise research brief.

output_examples.input: Search for electric vehicle battery news from the past week with a limit of 10.
output: A list of recent headlines related to electric vehicle batteries.
Each item includes source, article link, publication time, and author when available.
A short summary highlights recurring themes across the coverage.

output_examples.input: Monitor news about a product launch from the past 24 hours.
output_examples.output: A concise media brief shows the most relevant articles, publication sources, timing, and links for follow-up review.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment variable before running the skill.
Use specific keywords and narrow date windows to improve result relevance.
Review source links before using results in reports or decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys or other secrets into chat prompts.
Do not treat Google News results as complete market coverage without review.
Do not retry indefinitely after invalid authorization or repeated API failures.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate requests to BrowserAct.

faq.question: What information can it collect?
faq.answer: The documented workflow targets headlines, sources, article links, publication times, and authors when available.

faq.question: Does it run a local browser?
faq.answer: No. The script calls a BrowserAct workflow API instead of controlling a local browser directly.

faq.question: Can it summarize the news?
faq.answer: The skill collects structured results. Claude, Codex, or Claude Code can summarize the returned items after retrieval.

faq.question: Which date ranges are supported?
faq.answer: The skill documents any time, past hours, past 24 hours, past week, and past year.

faq.question: Are there known implementation issues?
faq.answer: Yes. The current script returns before its final result retrieval block, so the author should fix the polling control flow.
